# The Kavanaugh Report

> A comprehensive Montessori parenting resource offering practical guidance, activities, and philosophy for raising children from infancy through school age.

The Kavanaugh Report is hosted by Nicole Kavanaugh and features evidence-based Montessori parenting advice through blog articles, a podcast, and digital magazine. The site provides age-specific activities, practical life work guides, and seasonal resources aligned with Maria Montessori's educational philosophy for home implementation.

## Key Topics

- Montessori philosophy
- Montessori parenting
- Montessori at home
- Toddler activities
- Child development
- Practical life work
- Fine motor skills
- Educational toys
- Montessori method
- Parenting guide
- Seasonal activities
- Outdoor learning
- Nicole Kavanaugh
- Shelf Help Podcast
- Prepared adults

## Getting Started with Montessori

- [The Kavanaugh Report](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com): Homepage for Montessori parenting advice for babies, toddlers, and older children.
- [New to Montessori? Start Here](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/montessori.html): Beginner's guide to Montessori philosophy and implementation at home with children.
- [3 Considerations for Montessori Prepared Adults](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/01/3-considerations-for-montessori.html): Guide for parents becoming prepared adults in Montessori home environments.
- [About The Kavanaugh Report](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/our-family.html): About page featuring Nicole and her family's Montessori parenting journey.

## Podcast & Magazine

- [Shelf Help Podcast](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/shelf-help-podcast_23.html): Montessori parenting podcast by Nicole Kavanaugh and Amy Dorsch with practical advice.
- [Joyful Seasons Montessori Parenting Digital Magazine](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/joyful-seasons-montessori-parenting.html): Digital magazine with seasonal Montessori tips, recipes, and activities for families.

## Activities by Age & Stage

- [By Age](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/by-age.html): Content index organized by child developmental stages and ages.
- [At Newly 3: Montessori Toddler Activities](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/03/at-newly-3-montessori-toddler-activities.html): Montessori activities for 3-year-olds including fine motor and practical life work.
- [Montessori Friendly Realistic Puzzles for Toddlers](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/03/montessori-friendly-realistic-puzzles.html): Realistic puzzle recommendations for Montessori toddlers and preschoolers.
- [Montessori at Home: Tea with Toddlers](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/01/montessori-at-home-tea-with-toddlers.html): Practical life work guide for teaching toddlers tea-making activities.

## Seasonal & Themed Activities

- [Outdoor Montessori Work for the Summer](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/06/outdoor-montessori-work-for-summer.html): Summer Montessori activities for outdoor work shelves and fine motor skills.
- [Montessori Friendly Easter Baskets 2025](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2025/04/montessori-friendly-easter-baskets-2025.html): Easter basket gift ideas aligned with Montessori principles for all ages.
- [More Montessori Friendly Practical Stocking Stuffers](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/2024/12/more-montessori-friendly-practical.html): Practical stocking stuffer ideas for Montessori families across all ages.

## Free Resources

- [Montessori Freebies](https://www.thekavanaughreport.com/p/montessori-freebies.html): Free Montessori resources including potty training and activity downloads.
